title: Barn Dance Tutorial - Dick And Geneva's Western Barn Dance (P)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Lynn introduces the dance history and structure clearly before breaking down footwork step-by-step. She demonstrates alongside two assistants, separating leader and follower parts.

lesson_structure.note: DJ JR introduces the Barn Dance tutorial and instructor Lynn.
Lynn introduces herself, assistants Fredrick and Donna, and provides dance info.

steps_taught.name: Side touch together
steps_taught.description: Step side together side touch in alternating directions.

steps_taught.name: Turn spin out
steps_taught.description: Spin partner out and back in.

steps_taught.name: Quarter turn step hitch
steps_taught.description: Step hitch step hitch turning a quarter.

steps_taught.name: Rolling grapevine
steps_taught.description: Grapevine with turns and hip bumps.

what_works: Showing separate leader and follower footwork makes it easier to learn individual parts
what_hinders: Only showing front angle can make reverse footwork harder to mirror

quotes.text: Hey everybody it's DJ JR at the Barn in Sanford.
Level Beginner Count 32 Partner Dance Circle.
Here we go five six seven eight right together right touch.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor speaks to camera introducing the dance and teachers.
Three dancers demonstrate partner footwork while instructor counts.
Leader demonstrates footwork facing forward alone.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down the partner dance by teaching leader footwork and follower footwork separately before putting them together.
